name: ATHENA
tagline: AI-orchestrated electronics engineering and Virtual OEM

seo.title: ATHENA | Electronics engineering and Virtual OEM for power products
seo.description: ATHENA is an India-first, AI-orchestrated electronics engineering and Virtual OEM workflow for power products (SMPS, UPS), automated test equipment and new product development.

hero.title: Electronics engineering and Virtual OEM, run as one traceable workflow.
hero.body: ATHENA connects market intelligence, product definition, design, quality, sourcing and costing across eight linked nodes. Software agents prepare and cross-check the work; engineers review and approve it.

video.label: Product visual: ATHENA power product concept on a studio backdrop

problem.title: Hardware programmes fail in the hand-offs.
problem.intro: Most delays and cost overruns in power electronics come from decisions that were made in one team and discovered late in another.

items.title: Fragmented hand-offs
items.body: Requirements, design, sourcing and costing sit in separate tools and teams, and decisions get lost between them.

items.title: Late cost and compliance surprises
items.body: Cost, thermal and compliance issues surface after layout or tooling, when changes are most expensive.

items.title: Supply exposure
items.body: Single-source parts and long lead times are found at build time instead of at design time.

items.title: Test designed last
items.body: Production test is defined late, so field failures end up doing the validation.

proposition.title: One workflow from market signal to field data.
proposition.intro: ATHENA treats a product programme as a single record that every discipline reads from and writes to.

items.title: Eight connected nodes
items.body: Each node has defined inputs and outputs, so every specification, design file, quote and test result is traceable to its source.

items.title: Engineers decide, software prepares
items.body: AI agents draft, cross-check and track. Qualified engineers review and approve every release.

items.title: Virtual OEM
items.body: Own the product and the brand without owning a factory. ATHENA coordinates design, test and qualified manufacturing partners.

items.title: India-first
items.body: Requirements, design ownership and quality gates are run from India, for Indian operating conditions and applicable standards.

workflow.title: The eight-node workflow
workflow.intro: Follow a board down the line. Each station is one node: what it is for, what it consumes and what it hands on.

services.title: Engineering services across the product lifecycle
services.intro: Engage ATHENA for a single work package or for the full programme.

products.title: Concepts in the power product line
products.intro: These are engineering concepts, not catalogue items. No price or stock information is shown, and the ratings are indicative classes only.

process.title: From RFQ to milestones
process.intro: This is the planned project flow for the ATHENA platform. Until it is live, projects start with a direct conversation.

steps.title: RFQ
steps.body: You submit the requirement: application, ratings, standards, volumes and target dates.

steps.title: Bids
steps.body: Qualified engineering and manufacturing partners respond against one common scope, so bids are comparable.

steps.title: Award
steps.body: Scope, cost basis, deliverables and acceptance criteria are agreed before work begins.

steps.title: Milestones
steps.body: Work moves through gated reviews, with deliverables and payments tied to each milestone.

coDevelopment.title: Designed and governed in India, built with the wider supply ecosystem
coDevelopment.intro: ATHENA's operating model pairs Indian design ownership with access to China's component and tooling ecosystem, under one design record and one set of quality gates.
